consequential_difficulty_tests.reasoning_test: Aquinas excludes unaided saving choice, fatalism, autonomous willing completed by God, and prior merit; divine action moves willing internally. Chrysostom credits God while acknowledging the community’s actual costly faith, charity and endurance.
